name: Lathspell NPC (CR 7)
body:
LATHSPELL NPC
CR 7

The light-haired elf turns, drawing his sword, dark energy flowing down its blade. A dark raven alights on his shoulder.

XP 3,200
Elf lathspell 8
NE Medium humanoid (elf)
Init +2; Senses Perception +13, darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision

DEFENSE

AC 19 (+7 armor, +2 Dex), touch 12, flat-footed 17
hp 70 (8d10+ 16)
Fort +9, Ref +5, Will +3 (+3 on all saves vs. spells and spell-like abilities)
Defensive Abilities stalwart, stubborn soul

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft. (30 ft. when unarmored)
Melee +1 longsword +12, (1d8+ 6/19-20 [including arcane strike])
Melee [full attack] +1 longsword +9/+4 (1d4+ 11/19-20 [including Arcane Strike and Power Attack])
Ranged mwk longbow +10 (1d8/x3)
Ranged [full attack] mwk longbow +10/+ 5 (1d8/x3)
Special Attacks: cursed strike
Lathspell Spells Known (CL 8th; concentration +11)

2nd (4/day) acid arrow (DC 15), bestow curse (DC 15), haunting mists (DC 15), locate weakness, mirror image, touch of idiocy
1st (6/day) cause fear (DC 14), compel hostility (DC 14), disguise self, shield, jump
0th (at will) brand, chance*, detect magic, read magic, shared pain* (DC 13), touch of fatigue

TACTICS

Before Combat: Cyrus usually tries to have forewarning of combat and will prepare by casting shield and using a charge from his wand of invisibility. He will then attempt to reach the most advantageous position he can as combat begins.

During Combat: Cyrus attempts to strike the weakest enemy first if possible after giving himself a good position to strike from with his wand of invisibility. Often he will attempt to open combat with bestow curse to weaken a target, if he can’t get close he may use mirror image for added safety or jump to reach a better position.

Morale: Cyrus will almost never fight to the death, if being overpowered or outmaneuvered he will retreat to the best of his ability. Though if he has some grudge or vendetta he may do his best to leave a lasting wound, often in the form of a curse and stalk his enemies after he has been able to recover from any initial sortie.

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 14, Con 14, Int 12, Wis 10, Cha 16
Base Atk: +8; CMB: +11, CMD: 23
Feats: Arcane Strike, Riving Strike, Power Attack, Cornugon Smash
Skills: Bluff +14, Intimidate +14, Knowledge (Arcana) +12, Perception +13, Spellcraft +12, Stealth +2, Use Magic Device +14
Languages: Common, Elven, Abyssal
SQ: lathspell’s curse (curse of misfortune; shadow raven, vicious luck), cantrips, spells, cloak of menace, expanded knowledge (acid arrow, mirror image), armored casting (medium)
Combat Gear: +1 longsword, +1 spiked chainmail, masterwork spiked gauntlet (2), masterwork longbow, arrows (20), masterwork light steel shield, cloak of resistance +1, wand of invisibility (10 charges), 50 ft. of rope, masterwork daggers (2), potion of cure moderate wounds CL 3 (2), potion of fly CL 5, 275 gp, silver necklace (100 gp)

ABOUT

This NPC is lithe, even by elven standards. Possessed of a dour countenance and sickly pallor with a shock of near white hair. He wears a thick cloak and wears a set of fine chainmail, dyed in blacks and purples. Barbs and spikes worked into the chain, hanging from him like idle threats. His gauntlets are pointed and spiked and at his side is a longsword, a black lacquer scabbard detailed in silver. His cold eyes are crossed by scars, always on the edge of disdain.
